explanations.corridor_radius_m: Pilot presentation reaches only existing records this far from the native Red trail. It places nothing.
explanations.affected_radius_m: Existing trees/rocks near the source or affected host show the approved Red scar; yields and labels remain native.
explanations.boar_stride_m: Actual horizontal body travel per in-place walk clip. Does not control movement speed or damage.
explanations.root_pose_seconds: Idle rooting clip period while the native actor is still and not frozen/staggered.
explanations.grove_peak_emission: ART-02 peak core light; no added lights or bloom.
explanations.grove_minimum_light: ART-02 fraction of peak retained between travelling crests.
